resources.string: Translates German on-screen text into English. Triggered from the Quick Settings tile; uses on-device ML Kit translation and displays results as an accessibility overlay. Required so the Quick Settings tile can read the current screen and render translation cards.

Because this is a sideloaded APK, Android 13+ blocks enabling the service from the regular Accessibility screen. To allow it: 1) Long-press the app icon → App Info → three-dot menu → \"Allow restricted settings\". 2) Then go back to Settings → Accessibility → Screen Translator → enable.
Pull down the shade twice → edit → drag the \"Translate Screen\" tile into the active row. Then open any German app and tap the tile to translate the screen.
Der Schnellzugriff übersetzt deutschen Bildschirmtext ins Englische.
